title: vm-create-golden
description: Receipt for `testanyware vm create-golden`. Under --dry-run it carries the plan without mutating; on execution it identifies the created golden image. macOS, Linux, and Windows goldens all require a macOS host.

dry_run.description: Present and true when --dry-run was set; the plan is described but nothing is mutated.

platform.description: Target platform. macos, linux, and windows are all supported (all macOS-host work).

version.description: OS version to provision. macOS: a major number of 27 or later (default 27). The golden holds the latest release of that major. Any other value is a USAGE_ERROR. linux: 24.04 or 22.04 (default 24.04). windows: the release number (default 11).

name.description: Golden image name. Defaults to testanyware-golden-<platform>-<version>.

iso.description: windows only: path to the Windows ARM64 evaluation ISO (null when relying on the cached ISO).

release.description: macOS --dry-run only: the release that the base holds. It is the newest VirtualMac2,1 release of the major in Apple's IPSW catalogue (ADR-0027).

url.description: The URL of the restore image (IPSW).

base.description: macOS --dry-run only: the base VM that the run clones.

exists.description: Whether tart lists the base. When it is false, the run builds the base from the IPSW (about 25 GB download).

older.description: The other base VMs of the major. The run deletes them when the base is ready.

golden_exists.description: macOS --dry-run only: whether a golden of this name exists. The run replaces it when the new golden is ready.

created.description: Present and true on a successful (non-dry-run) golden creation.

boot_plan.description: macOS and Linux: ordered boot sequence that golden creation drives (macOS: 3 normal + 2 recovery = 5 boots; Linux: 2 normal boots).

mode.description: Whether the boot is a normal boot or a macOS Recovery boot.

actions.description: Human-readable summary of what this boot performs.

plan.description: windows only: ordered phases (single-boot unattended install + agent provisioning) that golden creation drives.

phase.description: Which phase of the unattended build this is.

actions.description: Human-readable summary of what this phase performs.
